title: Local contraction survives additive tensor pullback
statement: Let $p:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes and assume its tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive. Let $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ satisfy $\bigcup_i U_i=X$, and let $G$ be any $\mathcal O_X$-module. For the explicit augmentation $\epsilon:G[0]\to C$ [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction], both $\epsilon$ and $p^*(\operatorname{extend}\epsilon)$ are quasi-isomorphisms. There is no affineness, separatedness, quasi-coherence or flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: For each U_i use the ordered-insertion homotopy equivalence of the extended augmentation. Homotopy equivalences are quasi-isomorphisms. Exact open restriction commutes with homology. Detect invertibility of each homology map on the cover by detecting monomorphisms and the vanishing of the cokernel. Thus the extended augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism; quasiIso_extendMap_iff reflects this to the original natural-degree augmentation.

Identify the tensor-formula pullback with the canonical module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to module pushforward. Use pullback composition, the equality (p restricted to U_i) followed by U_i inclusion equals the inverse-image inclusion followed by p, and restrictFunctorIsoPullback to obtain tensorPullback(p) followed by restriction to p inverse U_i isomorphic to restriction to U_i followed by canonical pullback of p restricted to U_i. The latter pullback is additive; apply mapHomotopyEquiv to the local inverse and homotopies. Transport along the natural isomorphism using arrow_mk_iso_iff for homotopyEquivalences. This proves local homotopy equivalence on the inverse-image opens. Those opens cover by iSup_preimage_eq_top, so the same cover-detection argument gives the pulled-back quasi-isomorphism. Empty covers are handled by the same mono/cokernel detection, with no chosen index.
